text: Completed a 500-replication paired product-path validation in well-specified Gaussian iid and deliberately unmodelled stationary AR(1) regimes. Predeclared policy-equivalence margin: +/-0.005. Under the exact GLM, all-run minus training-only estimates were +0.0002205 for null (95% CI -0.0000014, +0.0004424) and -0.0042779 for signal (95% CI -0.0049124, -0.0036434): both equivalent. Under unmodelled AR(1), null remained equivalent (+0.0000164; CI -0.0000710, +0.0001038) but signal differed materially (-0.0093603; CI -0.0114013, -0.0073193). Decomposition shows -0.0089104 is learned-target shift; residual evaluator difference is -0.0004499 (CI -0.0025129, +0.0016130), within margin. Artifacts: benchmark-results/learned-metric-policy-validation.rds and learned-metric-policy-summary.csv; full public-path run took 726.4 s.
